description: An action pinned by digest under a floating major tag such as # v4 moves to an exact release such as # v4.3.1 on every version update. A floating tag moves upstream while the pinned digest stays, so a comment that keeps it goes stale, which jactionlint reports as a version comment that no longer matches the pin. helpers:pinGitHubActionDigestsToSemver in the default preset is what makes version updates write exact releases. Only version updates are asserted: the default preset also disables digest updates under a floating value, but Renovate applies update-level package rules and drops disabled updates after the extraction report this harness reads is written, so a disabled digest update that keeps # v4 still appears in it.
